name: Elune
summary: Across Azeroth, Elune is chiefly worshipped by the night elves as their protector and mother of Cenarius. The larger moon, the White Lady, is hers, and her gifts reach from healing and peace to lunar fury. Tauren know her as Mu'sha, the gentle left eye of the Earth Mother.

sections.title: The White Lady
sections.body: Elune is one of the few true deities known across Azeroth, bound to the night sky and the larger moon, the White Lady. Though she has never appeared in bodily form, night elven artists portray her as a radiant kaldorei with alabaster skin, silver hair, and eyes of pure moonlight. Ancient kaldorei legends say she rested in the depths of the Well of Eternity by day, whispering wisdom to the first night elves.

sections.title: The Sisters and the Forest
sections.body:
Night elven life, both sacred and civic, centers on devotion to Elune through the Sisterhood of Elune. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind leads this ancient order. The Sisters call on Elune to mend even lethal wounds, and turn her radiant wrath upon their foes with searing starlight.

Elune and the Great White Stag, Malorne, brought forth Cenarius. Through him, Elune's heavenly mysteries are bound to the druidic traditions that tend Kalimdor's wildlands.

sections.title: Aspects and Names
sections.body:
Elune is known for peace, harmony, and restoration, yet battle has its place in her worship. As the Night Warrior, she is a fierce patron of battle. She gathers the spirits of fallen heroes and sets them in the heavens, where they ride as stars.

The nomadic tauren call Elune Mu'sha, the radiant left eye of the Earth Mother. She lights the night and guides wandering hunters beside her fiery twin, An'she the sun.

faq.answer: Elune is the moon goddess chiefly worshipped by the night elves and one of Azeroth's few true deities. She is associated with healing, nature, peace, and the White Lady, the world's larger moon.

faq.q: Has Elune ever appeared in person?
faq.answer: Elune has never appeared in physical form on Azeroth. Kaldorei artists depict her as a radiant night elf maiden crowned in platinum, with long silver hair and glowing moonlight eyes. Her true cosmic shape remains a mystery.

The Night Warrior is Elune's fiercest aspect and her patronage of battle. In this form, her wrath rises in combat, and she lifts the spirits of courageous fallen warriors into the night sky to ride among the stars.

faq.q: How is Elune related to Cenarius?
faq.answer: Elune and the wild stag demigod Malorne brought forth Cenarius. He inherited his mother's deep love for living creatures and his father's bond with the natural wild and the Emerald Dream.
Yes. Tauren call Elune Mu'sha, the gentle left eye of the Earth Mother. In their myths, she watches over the world by night alongside her solar brother, An'she.

faq.q: Who leads the worship of Elune in Kalimdor?
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind leads the Sisterhood of Elune in Kalimdor. The Sisterhood is the chief spiritual and civic authority among the night elves.

angles.text: As a night elf, your civilization looks to the Mother Moon, from the ruling Sisterhood to the moonlight bathing your woodland settlements.
As a tauren, your ancestral myths praise Mu'sha, the left eye of the Earth Mother, for watching over the tribes and creatures of the dark.
As a night elf priest, you draw divine spells and celestial fury from Elune's guidance. You wield radiant moonlight rather than the Holy Light worshipped in the eastern kingdoms.
As a druid, you are kin to the living wild, and Elune's celestial influence is woven into your astral powers as the divine mother of Lord Cenarius.
